scope: supporting reduction only; full conjecture remains open

lpp_hypotheses.detail: Applied only to orthogonal marginals of genuine original-coordinate product banks with scalar density caps <=1.

conditional_linearization.detail: Conditioning on Z leaves (2Dz+alpha)^T X+G(z), with X an untouched original-coordinate product bank.

two_dimensional_density_cap.detail: V_2^T Z has density cap <=2; affine map w=2 Sigma_2 z2+shift has determinant 4 d1 d2, hence cap <=1/(2 d1 d2).

bathtub_inverse_radius.detail: Centered disk of density H and area 1/H maximizes the radial decreasing kernel.

rank_one_collar.detail: If d1 d2<theta and d2<=d1, then d2^2<=d1d2<theta; Eckart-Young gives dist_op(D,rank<=1)=d2<sqrt(theta).

partner_singular_value_comparison.detail: P_r C=P_r D J with P_r and J contractions/isometries, so s_j(P_r C)<=s_j(D), hence c1 c2<=d1 d2.

continuity.detail: The conditional negative-moment proof establishes absolute continuity and an L-infinity density bound, not a generic continuous representative.
